verdict.rationale: Together AI documents serving custom models it trained itself: you fine-tune with LoRA or full fine-tuning, and it handles data upload, training, hosting and inference, including deploying fine-tuned models to dedicated endpoints. Nothing in the evidence shows uploading externally trained weights or LoRA adapters, which is the core 'upload your own' part of the story. Missing for 10: documented upload/import of externally trained model weights, upload and serving of externally trained LoRA adapters (e.g. serverless multi-LoRA), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can upload and serve my own custom model weights or LoRA adapters

citations.quote: Fine-tuned models: Deploy a model you fine-tuned from a supported base model.
Together AI handles the full lifecycle: data upload, training, hosting, and inference on a dedicated endpoint.
Fine-tune models on your own data and deploy them for inference.
LoRA: Trains a small set of adapter weights on top of the frozen base model
